notes: GPUI PANELS. The target UI framework is GPUI 0.2.2 (Zed's framework), not React, and you have no training knowledge of its exact API. Before writing, read: the finished panel crates as worked examples (rever-ui-traffic, rever-ui-websocket, rever-ui-menus: their src and examples/preview.rs show how views, listeners, hover, scrolling, text fields, theme, strings and previews are done here), every file in rever-ui-kit/src, and vendor/gpui/src/elements/*.rs plus vendor/gpui/examples/*.rs for exact method names. Build the store as a struct with methods and two view structs implementing gpui::Render that reproduce the React components' layout, sizes, colors and behaviors (editing method, URL, headers and body; sending; the response view with status, headers, body and timing; history of sends; for the WebSocket repeater the connection picker, message composer and sequence runner). Multi-line editing: rever_ui_kit's TextInput is single-line; write the multi-line editor you need in this crate, modeled on rever-ui-kit/src/text_input.rs (keep IME handling; test the pure parts such as cursor movement across lines). Sending goes through IPC in the React code: take it as a trait object or boxed async closure (request in, response out) so the host can supply the real sender later; the preview supplies a fake. Already ported helpers: rever-ui-state (ws_sequence, format_json), rever-ui-traffic's JSON view if it is exported. Colors and sizes come from src/renderer/src/styles.css (tokens in rever_ui_kit::theme::Theme; define a missing one locally and list it). User-facing strings go through `rever_ui_kit::i18n::Lang::t(key)` with the keys the TSX uses. Keep logic in plain functions with Korean-named unit tests; a file gets the `Port of` marker only when its behaviors are all there. Preview: fill examples/preview.rs so `cargo run -p rever-ui-repeater --example preview_repeater` shows both panels with fixture data; capture with `scripts/capture-window.sh preview_repeater /tmp/preview_repeater.png`, read the PNG, compare with the TSX, fix what is off. Do not bring windows to the front, do not capture the screen any other way, do not run the `rever` app, and never run cargo without `-p` (other crates in the workspace are mid-edit).
